fusions.name: Fresh Legs
fusions.desc: Fires a bolt of water that deals 6 damage. Its damage rises 10% for every 10% of health the target still has, up to 50%. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Stampede Wake
fusions.desc: Sends a wake 9 tiles long ahead of you, dealing 30 damage to everything in it. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Long Ride Home
fusions.desc: Increases your stamina recovery by 50% for 20 seconds.

fusions.name: Unflagging Stride
fusions.desc: When you spend stamina, you regain 3 stamina. Once every 8 seconds.
